description: This file generates a TypeScript module with bundled provider authentication environment variables by collecting plugin sources, normalizing environment variables, and rendering TypeScript code. It includes functions for normalization, collection, rendering, and writing output, as well as a CLI report utility.

methods.name: normalizeProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Normalizes provider authentication environment variables by trimming provider IDs and envVars, filtering invalid entries, and sorting them.

methods.name: collectBundledProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Collects bundled provider auth environment variables from plugin sources, normalizes them, and returns a sorted object mapping provider IDs to env variables.

methods.name: renderBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Generates a TypeScript module string defining a constant with provider auth env variables in a formatted manner.

methods.name: writeBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Writes the rendered TypeScript module to a specified file path, defaulting to a predefined output path.
